# kithmoot-android

> A native Kotlin implementation of the KithMoot protocol: an open workspace with rooms, chat and calls over Nostr, encrypted end to end, where one person on several devices appears to the room as one participant. It is the second, independent implementation, checked against the published interop vectors rather than against the TypeScript reference client (forgesworn/kithmoot).

## Modules

- `:protocol`: pure JVM, no Android dependencies. Package `dev.forgesworn.kithmoot`: `crypto` (BIP-340, NIP-44 v2), `protocol` (events, rooms, credentials, roster, signalling, access, TURN) and `vmls` (the VMLS/1 leaf-binding reader). Not published to any repository; consume it as `project(":protocol")`.
- `:app`: the Android application (relay pool, room session, WebRTC media, encrypted storage, Compose UI). Requires Android 13 or later.
- `:g5-signer`: a NIP-55 fixture signer app with deterministic keys, never a real identity, driven by the instrumented G5 tests.
- `:mesh-radio`: the native BLE engine, compiled from pinned upstream sources fetched by `scripts/prepare-mesh-radio.py`.
- `:sdk-signet-contacts`: the pinned Signet contacts SDK source, built as a JVM library.

## Build and test

Use JDK 21 and an Android SDK with platform 35 and build tools 35.0.0 (`ANDROID_HOME`, or `sdk.dir` in the gitignored `local.properties`). `:protocol:test` needs no preparation. Every `:app` task needs the three pinned bundles prepared first:

```sh
scripts/fetch-link-bridge.sh build/link-ffi-android.zip
python3 scripts/prepare-link-bridge.py build/link-ffi-android.zip
scripts/fetch-vmls-ffi.sh build/vmls-ffi-android.zip
python3 scripts/prepare-vmls-ffi.py build/vmls-ffi-android.zip
python3 scripts/prepare-mesh-radio.py
./gradlew :protocol:test :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:lintDebug :app:lintRelease :app:assembleDebug :app:assembleRelease
```

## Interop vectors

- `protocol/src/test/resources/kithmoot-vectors.json` is a verbatim copy of the published vectors, never edited by hand: 258 vectors in 33 groups. `VectorCoverageTest` fails the build if a vector or a group's negative cases go missing.
- Run in `:protocol:test`: roomDerivation, joinUrl, deviceCredential, rosterEvent, signalWrap, signalCompatibility, kindredProof, accessEvaluation, turnCredential, roomEpoch (the peek only), epochRequestAdmission, callBell, roomRelays, roomName, meeting, memberPass, servicePolicy, serviceScope, serviceAudience.
- Run in `:app:testDebugUnitTest`: chatThread, chatEdit, chatOrder, chatRetract, chatMention, chatInvite, readPosition and the roomName events (`MessageLayerVectorsTest`), chatHistory (`ChatHistoryVectorsTest`) and chatAttachment (`ChatAttachmentVectorsTest`).
- Counted but not run, because nothing implements them yet: channelDerivation, roomEpoch beyond the peek, agentOwnership, approvalControl, roomDescriptor, verificationWords. Do not mark them passing.
